item.description:
Consultant tutorial: defining shock, the four mechanisms with the haemodynamic pattern for each, and the limits of bedside perfusion signs in a ventilated patient. Then an examiner and candidate work a cardiogenic versus septic shock data question. Study day Wednesday 28 October.
